name: browser-doom
description: A playable, fully client-side DOOM that runs in the browser. Thin wrapper by lofihippo around the doomgeneric WebAssembly engine (GPL-2.0, by ozkl, from id Software's LinuxDOOM) and Freedoom Phase 1 game data (BSD), with runtime loading of user WADs.
author: lofihippo (browser wrapper only; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for engine and game-data authors)
